visual_action: In the Oval Office, a group of people stand around the Resolute Desk where Donald Trump is seated. They have their hands on or near his shoulders and back as they bow their heads in prayer. The camera slowly pans across the scene.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is seated at the desk and is the subject of the prayer being said over him.

cast.name: Unnamed man
cast.evidence: A man's voice is heard leading the prayer for Donald Trump.

cast.name: God
cast.evidence: The prayer repeatedly invokes God, and the on-screen text reads 'ONE NATION UNDER GOD'.

cast.name: US Armed Forces
cast.evidence: The prayer asks for protection over 'our troops and all of our men and women serving in our armed forces'.

spoken_summary: An unidentified man leads a prayer over Donald Trump in the Oval Office. He asks for God's grace and protection for Trump and for U.S. troops. The man prays that God will give Trump the strength to lead the nation back to being 'one nation under God, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all,' and concludes by asking for a heavenly blessing on Trump in Jesus' name.
audio_music: The audio consists entirely of a man's voice speaking a prayer in a serious, reverent tone. There is no music or other sound.
editing_pacing: The video is a single, continuous shot with slow panning camera movement. The pacing is slow and deliberate.
central_claim: Donald Trump is a pious leader who is being divinely blessed to lead America as 'one nation under God'.
intended_effect: To inspire feelings of reverence, patriotism, and support for Donald Trump as a God-fearing leader.
